messages.subject: major include/using problems and <> vs. ""
parts:
We need to rethink the way the usings and includes
are happening because they're being defined at way
too high a scope.

I didn't realize this before, but putting a using
in the namespace brings it into the whole namespace.

We want to limit includes and usings as much as
possible to avoid name clashes. ALL of the code is
going to need to be reviewed for this problem,
as I introduced it all over the place before I knew
any better.

I think we should go with <>-style includes in
case Stan gets installed or people want to use
an installed Boost or Eigen. Is that right? In any
case, we need to figure out how to do this consistently.
Right now, there's a mix of both.

- Bob
